strategy.emotion_policy: AUTO_DEFAULT. The model auto-detects emotion; an explicit voice_setting.emotion requires a per-unit justification, must be documented for speech-2.8-hd, and calm may appear at most once and never as a majority. The v2 round set calm on 5 of 7 segments; this plan sets it on none.
strategy.pause_policy: Punctuation first. <#x#> markers only where a pause_intent declares a role; durations 0.2-0.5 s, at most two per unit, anchors must be unique; mapped text must pass the provider's documented marker validation before use.
strategy.speed_policy: STEADY is the default and emits no speed field. A group may run at 0.95-1.08 only when every member unit intends the same direction and a justification is declared.
strategy.grouping_policy: Synthesis boundaries follow complete narrative intent, not sentences: 8 units become 4 groups, every group is multi-unit, and a single-unit group is legal only with a declared reason and a differing control.
